items.question: What makes this different from a chatbot?
items.answer: The coworker operates inside a persistent workspace with project files, tools, and reusable instructions. It can produce and organize artifacts instead of only returning an answer.

items.question: Does Floatboat upload every local file?
items.answer: No. Access is scoped to the work you choose. Local-first execution is intended to avoid unnecessary upload loops and to keep sensitive project material under clearer control.

items.question: Can I see what the agent is doing?
items.answer: Yes. The workspace is designed around visible steps, outputs, and approval boundaries rather than invisible background automation.

items.question: Can I reuse a successful workflow?
items.answer: Yes. Repeatable instructions can become skills or Combos so the next project starts with a tested working method.
